statuses.summary: The installed marketplace and project contract are current.
An upgrade is required and all preflight checks passed.
actions: Review and approve a deterministic upgrade plan.

statuses.summary: An upgrade is required but one or more safety checks block mutation.
actions: Run status again from a new session.

statuses.summary: A fingerprint-bound plan is ready for final approval.
actions: Review the plan id and exact changes.

statuses.summary: An upgrade owns the maintenance lock.
actions: Do not start normal marketplace work.
Wait for completion or follow recovery guidance.

statuses.summary: A durable journal records an incomplete upgrade.
actions: Run the recorded recovery path before any other marketplace mutation.

statuses.summary: The upgrade completed, but the current session still holds pre-upgrade runtime context.
actions: Start a fresh session before normal work.

statuses.summary: Managed project upgrade files are applied but not yet committed for review.
actions: Open and merge the project upgrade pull request.
Start a fresh session from the merged revision.
